faqs.question: How long does a typical Progressive Web App engagement take?
faqs.answer: MVPs often launch in 6–12 weeks depending on offline needs, auth, and device feature scope.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We align with your design system, backend APIs, and release process, and we train stakeholders on PWA constraints.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Install/engagement rates, offline task completion, performance on mid-tier mobiles, and conversion vs your prior mobile web.

faqs.question: When is a PWA better than a native app?
faqs.answer: When distribution speed, shared web codebase, and installability matter more than deep OS integrations. We advise honestly either way.

faqs.question: Offline support included?
faqs.answer: Where it creates value — caching strategies, background sync, and clear UX for offline/online transitions.

faqs.question: Push notifications?
faqs.answer: Supported where browsers and consent flows allow. We implement permission UX carefully to protect trust.

faqs.question: iOS limitations?
faqs.answer: We design around known Safari/PWA constraints and set stakeholder expectations early — no surprise feature gaps.

faqs.question: Can you wrap an existing Next.js site?
faqs.answer: Often yes. We add service workers, manifest, and resilient data patterns without rewriting the entire product.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Define must-have mobile journeys. We prototype critical flows and validate performance on real devices.

faqs.question: Who ships the PWA?
faqs.answer: Front-end engineers specializing in performance and mobile UX, with QA across devices and network conditions.
